Description: The strategy used to select and fragment precursor ions during mass spectrometry data collection
Valid Values: data-dependent acquisition, data-independent acquisition, targeted acquisition

Description: A mass spectrometry acquisition strategy in which the instrument dynamically selects the most abundant precursor ions detected in a survey scan for subsequent fragmentation and MS2 analysis
A mass spectrometry acquisition strategy in which all precursor ions within a defined m/z isolation window are fragmented simultaneously, regardless of abundance

A mass spectrometry acquisition strategy in which a predefined set of specific precursor and product ion pairs are selectively monitored, as in selected reaction monitoring (SRM/MRM) or parallel reaction monitoring (PRM)
